module_summary: Shared-bus AXI-Lite crossbar: a round-robin arbiter grants one slave-port read or write, an FSM decodes the address to a master port and store-and-forwards address, data and response through holding registers.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Transaction FSM: idle, decode, write, write response, write drop, read, wait idle.

anchors.name: m_select_reg
anchors.why: Decoded master port index; selects current_m_axil_* signals and which master handshake asserts.

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant from round-robin arbiter over slave read/write requests; qualifies acknowledge.

anchors.name: axil_addr_reg
anchors.why: Latched transaction address, decoded against master regions and broadcast to master awaddr/araddr.

anchors.name: axil_data_reg
anchors.why: Store-and-forward data register: write data to masters, read data back to slaves.

anchors.name: s_select
anchors.why: Granted slave port index from grant_encoded; muxes current_s_axil_* and slave handshakes.

anchors.name: match
anchors.why: Address decode hit flag; chooses forward to master versus decode-error response.

anchors.name: read
anchors.why: Granted request is read vs write; steers address capture and FSM branch.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid; starts transaction from idle and ends wait-idle.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valids form even arbiter request bits.

anchors.name: s_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read-address valids form odd arbiter request bits.

anchors.name: axil_resp_reg
anchors.why: Held bresp/rresp from master or decode error, broadcast to slave response ports.

anchors.name: axil_prot_reg
anchors.why: Latched protection bits; checked for secure masters and forwarded to masters.

anchors.name: axil_wstrb_reg
anchors.why: Latched write strobes forwarded to master wstrb.

anchors.name: axil_addr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Pending address flag; issues master awvalid/arvalid once per transaction.

anchors.name: request
anchors.why: Arbiter request vector built from slave awvalid/arvalid.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Releases arbiter grant on completed slave response handshake.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant index; LSB gives read, upper bits give s_select.

anchors.name: m_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Master write-address valid driven from registered handshake.

anchors.name: m_axil_arvalid
anchors.why: Master read-address valid driven from registered handshake.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Slave write response valid; with bready acknowledges arbiter.

anchors.name: s_axil_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave read data valid; with rready acknowledges arbiter.

groups.name: transaction_fsm
groups.description: Sequences address capture, decode, data forwarding and response return per granted transaction.

groups.name: request_arbiter
groups.description: Round-robin arbiter choosing one slave read or write request at a time.

groups.name: slave_mux
groups.description: Selects the granted slave port signals via s_select.

groups.name: master_decode_mux
groups.description: Address-region decode picks master port; m_select_reg muxes master signals.

groups.name: holding_registers
groups.description: Store-and-forward address, data, strobe, prot and response registers.

groups.name: handshake_registers
groups.description: Registered per-port valid/ready signals for slave and master AXI-Lite channels.
